name: D-EVE in you
source:
Ren is the son of the president of Hiura Productions talent agency. While the company used to produce lots of top idols in the past, now it is managed solely by them with no current idols to their name. They wish to regain their past glory and a huge opportunity appears. The idol-raising Houou Girls’ School was recently built and the principal allows Hiura Productions to secure a classroom. However, his father Yukichi suddenly collapses and Ren is forced to take over as the role of lecturer instead. With limited knowledge about how to raise idols, will he be able to bring the 4-girl idol unit D-EVE to stardom?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/09/13/september-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
火浦炼是火浦制作这家艺能事务所社长的儿子。公司过去曾培养出众多顶尖偶像，如今却只剩他们经营，旗下没有任何现役偶像。他们希望重现往日荣光，机会突然出现：偶像养成学校“凤王女子学院”最近落成，校长允许火浦制作在校内取得一间教室。

然而，父亲火浦幸吉突然倒下，炼不得不接替他担任讲师。对偶像养成所知有限的他，能否将四人偶像组合D-EVE带上明星之路？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/09/13/september-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
